territorial_scope.description: EU-wide directive addressed to Member States, which implement its rules in national law; the press publisher right applies to publishers established in a Member State.

evidence.quote: This Directive is addressed to the Member States.

summary.short: EU directive harmonising copyright rules for the digital single market. Obliges Member States to provide mandatory exceptions for text and data mining, digital teaching and preservation, and rules on press publishers' rights, online content-sharing platforms and authors' remuneration. Transposition deadline 7 June 2021.
summary.long: Directive (EU) 2019/790 sets harmonised EU copyright rules and amends Directives 96/9/EC and 2001/29/EC. Title II requires Member States to provide mandatory exceptions for text and data mining for scientific research (Art. 3) and for text and data mining generally (Art. 4), for digital illustration for teaching (Art. 5) and for cultural heritage preservation (Art. 6), and makes contrary contract terms unenforceable (Art. 7). Title III covers out-of-commerce works, cross-border uses, a publicity portal, collective licensing with extended effect (Art. 12) and a negotiation mechanism for video-on-demand licensing (Art. 13). Title IV grants publishers of press publications a right over online uses by information society service providers (Art. 15). It makes online content-sharing service providers liable for unauthorised communications to the public unless they show best efforts and expeditious takedown, with a reduced regime for services available for less than three years with annual turnover below EUR 10 million (Art. 17). It sets transparency, contract adjustment and revocation rules for authors and performers (Arts 18-22). Member States transpose by 7 June 2021, and the Directive applies to works protected on or after that date (Arts 26, 29).

notes: Relations come from operative articles, Art. 1(2), Art. 24 and the preamble citation of the legal basis. Recitals naming other instruments (e.g. Directive 93/83/EEC, Regulation (EC) No 593/2008) are not coded. Art. 2(6) says 'for profit-making purposes' while recital 62 says 'either directly or indirectly'; the operative text is coded. Art. 15(3) omits 'and' before 'of the Council' in the citation of Directive (EU) 2017/1564. Dates stated in the text: application from 7 June 2021 (Art. 26(1)), transposition by 7 June 2021 (Art. 29(1)), transparency obligation from 7 June 2022 (Art. 27), and 6 June 2019 as reference date (Arts 15(4), 17(10)). The section_status entry is present only because the schema requires it; relation entries are listed above.
